item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump caps correspondents’ dinner with “Trump 2028” joke
item.description: At the rescheduled correspondents’ dinner, Trump joked about a third term, mocked rivals and sparred with the press in an hourlong speech.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] One dead in shooting outside Plant City nightclub: HCSO
item.description: The Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office (HCSO) is investigating a fatal shooting that happened early Saturday morning outside a Plant City nightclub.
